# The character tables of 3GPP TS 23.038 V20.0.0 (23038-k00.docx), cell by
# cell as printed: clauses 6.2.1 and 6.2.1.1, and Annex A.2 and A.3 (there
# is no Spanish locking shift table, A.3.2 is Void).
#
# Each table is a "table" line naming it and its clause, then 16 rows, one
# for each low nibble 0x0-0xF, of 8 cells, one for each high nibble 0x0-0x7,
# as the specification lays them out. A cell holds the printed text: a
# character, 4 hex digits of a Unicode code point, SP, LF or CR, the number
# of the note that is the only content of the cell, such as "1)", or "·"
# (U+00B7) for an empty cell.

table Default 6.2.1 # GSM 7 bit default alphabet
@ Δ SP 0 ¡ P ¿ p
£ _ ! 1 A Q a q
$ Φ " 2 B R b r
¥ Γ # 3 C S c s
è Λ ¤ 4 D T d t
é Ω % 5 E U e u
ù Π & 6 F V f v
ì Ψ ' 7 G W g w
ò Σ ( 8 H X h x
Ç Θ ) 9 I Y i y
LF Ξ * : J Z j z
Ø 1) + ; K Ä k ä
ø Æ , < L Ö l ö
CR æ - = M Ñ m ñ
Å ß . > N Ü n ü
å É / ? O § o à
